standard_prerequisites.use: Places the points of finite type of the substack among those of the stack inside the subset.

standard_prerequisites.name: The description of points of finite type through closed points of affine presentations
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked at the end of the counted proof (source lines 3789-3793)
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces a point of finite type on the substack from a closed point of an affine presentation.

core_obligations: Reduce to a substack: present the locally closed subset as the space of the reduced induced substack structure on it (proof lines 3779-3783)

Compare points of finite type: since the immersion is locally of finite type, the points of finite type of the substack are points of finite type of the ambient stack lying in the subset (proof lines 3784-3788)

Existence: any nonempty affine scheme with a smooth morphism to the substack has a closed point, which by the description of points of finite type is a point of finite type of the substack (proof lines 3789-3794)
proof_roadmap: 把 T 实现为既约诱导闭子栈 Z 的空间。
浸入局部有限型 ⇒ Z 的有限型点都是 X 的有限型点且落在 T 内。
非空仿射概型 U 光滑映到 Z 必有闭点 ⇒ 由有限型点的刻画 Z 至少有一个有限型点。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that every nonempty locally closed subset of the space of an algebraic stack meets the set of points of finite type, and that for a closed subset that intersection is dense (author lemma at source lines 3766-3777, label lemma-enough-finite-type-points). The proof (source lines 3779-3795) realises the subset as the space of its reduced induced substack, compares points of finite type along the immersion, and produces one from a closed point of an affine presentation (proof lines 3779-3794). The reduction to the substack and the comparison of finite type points are the content. H2.
